description_en: Removes one or more tags from specified resources
description_zh: 调用UntagResources接口解除指定资源和标签之间的绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun sae untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type application --resource-ids d42921c4-5433-4abd-8075-0e536f8b0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UntagResources

parameters.help_en: The resource type. Only `application` is supported
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. To specify multiple resource IDs, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。可填写多个资源ID，用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The tag keys. To specify multiple tag keys, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 标签键列表。可填写多个标签键，用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: tag_keys

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to remove all tags. This parameter applies only when TagKeys is not specified. Valid values:

true: All tags are removed.

false: Only the tags specified in the TagKeys parameter are removed
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除所有标签，当已传入标签键时生效。取值说明如下：

true：删除所有标签。
false：不删除所有标签
parameters.name: delete_all

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

2xx: The request was successful.

3xx: The request was redirected.

4xx: A client error occurred.

5xx: A server error occurred
Code.description_zh:
接口状态或POP错误码。取值说明如下：

2xx：成功。
3xx：重定向。
4xx：请求错误。
5xx：服务器错误

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

This parameter is not returned on a successful request.

This parameter is returned on a failed request. For more information, see the Error codes section in this topic
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。取值说明如下：

请求成功：不返回ErrorCode字段。
请求失败：返回ErrorCode字段。具体信息，请参见本文的错误码列表

Message.description_en:
The response message.

A successful request returns success.

A failed request returns an error code
Message.description_zh:
附加信息。取值说明如下：

请求正常，返回success。
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
删除标签是否成功。取值说明如下：

true：删除成功。
false：删除失败

TraceId.description_en: The trace ID for querying the details of a call
TraceId.description_zh: 调用链ID，用于精确查询调用信息
